question: The magnitude and direction of the current in the following circuit is
diagram_alt: Loop ABCD: from A, 2 Ω, a 10 V cell, point E, a 5 V cell and 1 Ω to B; 7 Ω from C to D
solution:
The two cells have their positive terminals facing each other at E, so they oppose. The $10$ V cell wins, and the net emf is $10 - 5 = 5$ V.

Total resistance: $2 + 1 + 7 = 10\ \Omega$.

$$I = \frac{5}{10} = 0.5\ \text{A}$$

The $10$ V cell drives current out of its positive terminal towards E, i.e. from A to B through E.
